postinstall.command:
curl -fsSL https://x.ai/cli/install.sh | bash
if [ -d /root/.grok ]; then
    rm -rf /opt/grok
    mv /root/.grok /opt/grok
    chmod -R a+rX /opt/grok
    ln -sf /opt/grok/bin/grok /usr/local/bin/grok
fi
command -v grok >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo 'WARNING: grok not on PATH after install'

npx --yes @socketsecurity/cli npm install -g --silent @moonshot-ai/kimi-code
command -v kimi >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo 'WARNING: kimi not on PATH after install'

postinstall.description: Oh My Pi CLI (omp) + bun runtime
postinstall.command:
export BUN_INSTALL=/opt/bun
curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash
if [ -x /opt/bun/bin/bun ]; then
    chmod -R a+rX /opt/bun
    ln -sf /opt/bun/bin/bun /usr/local/bin/bun
fi
command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo 'WARNING: bun not on PATH after install (omp needs it)'
npx --yes @socketsecurity/cli npm install -g --silent @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent || npm install -g --silent @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent
command -v omp >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo 'WARNING: omp not on PATH after install'

# Hermes Agent (Nous Research): code, managed Python and tools in
# /opt/hermes, root-owned. Each user's shell builds that user's own
# dependency environment from it (`hermes pm repair`: seconds, offline).
# Best effort: a failed install leaves nothing behind, and hermes then
# installs itself per user on first use, as on older images.
ok=
for i in 1 2; do
    if curl -fsSL https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/install.sh \
            | bash -s -- --non-interactive --skip-browser --skip-computer-use \
                --dir /opt/hermes/hermes-agent --hermes-home /opt/hermes \
            && [ -x /opt/hermes/hermes-agent/.hermes/bin/hermes ]; then
        ok=1; break
    fi
done
if [ -n "$ok" ]; then
    # Readable by all, but not root's own data root (its .env stays 0600).
    # A layout change upstream must not fail the image build (bash -e).
    chmod a+rx /opt/hermes
    for d in /opt/hermes/hermes-agent /opt/hermes/tools /opt/hermes/installs; do
        if [ -d "$d" ]; then chmod -R a+rX "$d"; fi
    done
    if [ -f /opt/hermes/config.yaml ]; then chmod a+r /opt/hermes/config.yaml; fi
    # Each workspace sets up its own environment from here, offline: the
    # packages the install downloaded go to the payload cache Hermes seeds
    # every user's cache from (root's own uv cache is read by nobody else),
    # and the store's install lock and record must open for every user
    # ("Permission denied: .../.install.lock"). A lock file holds nothing;
    # the record holds no secret.
    if [ -d /opt/hermes/cache/uv ] && [ ! -e /opt/hermes/uv-cache ]; then
        mv /opt/hermes/cache/uv /opt/hermes/uv-cache
    fi
    if [ -d /opt/hermes/uv-cache ]; then chmod -R a+rX /opt/hermes/uv-cache; fi
    if [ -d /opt/hermes/tools ]; then
        touch /opt/hermes/tools/.install.lock
        chmod 666 /opt/hermes/tools/.install.lock
        if [ -f /opt/hermes/tools/facts.json ]; then chmod a+r /opt/hermes/tools/facts.json; fi
    fi
    ln -sf /opt/hermes/hermes-agent/.hermes/bin/hermes /usr/local/bin/hermes
else
    rm -rf /opt/hermes /usr/local/bin/hermes
    echo 'WARNING: Hermes Agent not installed in /opt; hermes installs itself per user instead'
fi

ARCH=$(uname -m)
case "$ARCH" in aarch64|arm64) K=arm ;; x86_64) K=x86_64 ;; *) echo "unsupported arch $ARCH"; exit 0 ;; esac
URL="https://dl.google.com/dl/cloudsdk/channels/rapid/downloads/google-cloud-cli-linux-${K}.tar.gz"
TMP=$(mktemp -d)
curl -fsSL "$URL" -o "$TMP/gcloud.tar.gz"
tar -xzf "$TMP/gcloud.tar.gz" -C /opt
/opt/google-cloud-sdk/install.sh --quiet --usage-reporting=false --path-update=false --command-completion=false || true
ln -sf /opt/google-cloud-sdk/bin/gcloud  /usr/local/bin/gcloud
ln -sf /opt/google-cloud-sdk/bin/gsutil  /usr/local/bin/gsutil
ln -sf /opt/google-cloud-sdk/bin/bq      /usr/local/bin/bq
rm -rf "$TMP"
